title: rhinanthus alpinus
intro: Rhinanthus alpinus, commonly known as Alpenrose, is a flowering plant species within the broomrape family (Orobanchaceae). Alpenrose is known for its health benefits, including its potential to support immune function and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids that have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
